title: CTA leg flips by roll-off -> move the flip's way
hypothesis: When a 1/3/12-month trend leg will flip by roll-off within 5 days at today's price, the market moves in the direction of the flip over the next 5 trading days more than on other days (trend-follower flows).
source: Hurst, Ooi & Pedersen; Baltas & Kosowski; agent 8 CTA levels
flag_doc: agent 8 CTA levels: a trend leg (21/63/252 days) flips by roll-off within 5 days at today's price; side = the sign the soonest leg flips to

recall_probe.question: Before the run: will the effect have the registered sign and pass the gate?

llm_window: LLM-in-sample: 8290 of 8290 episodes fall before the drafting model's boundary 2026-10-16; the model picked no number; the flag rule came from the literature and predates this test
audit_subject: CTA leg flips by roll-off -> move the flip's way cta_rolloff_flip flag
data_note: Outcomes use agent 8's spliced daily returns (Yahoo front-month closes, roll jumps screened against a spot or index proxy where one exists; markets without a proxy keep unadjusted roll days).
